# Blender's shader nodes by version

Every shader node of the supported Blender versions (5.0.0, 5.1.2, 5.2.3 LTS, 5.3.0), the version it exists from, and whether it is in the Cycles node space of Cinema 4D. With an older Blender chosen in the Preferences, a node of a newer version is left out of what is sent, and so are its wires, with a line in the console; the Node Editor marks such a node (`docs/reference/c4d-sdk.md`, "A node the chosen Blender does not have").

| Node | Blender type | From | In the node space |
|---|---|---|---|
| AOV Output | `ShaderNodeOutputAOV` | 5.0 | left out: writes a custom AOV, which needs AOVs in the view layer that the plugin does not make |
| Add Shader | `ShaderNodeAddShader` | 5.0 | yes, in Shader |
| Ambient Occlusion | `ShaderNodeAmbientOcclusion` | 5.0 | yes, in Input |
| Attribute | `ShaderNodeAttribute` | 5.0 | yes, in Input |
| Background | `ShaderNodeBackground` | 5.0 | yes, in Shader |
| Bevel | `ShaderNodeBevel` | 5.0 | yes, in Input |
| Blackbody | `ShaderNodeBlackbody` | 5.0 | yes, in Color |
| Brick Texture | `ShaderNodeTexBrick` | 5.0 | yes, in Texture |
| Brightness/Contrast | `ShaderNodeBrightContrast` | 5.0 | yes, in Color |
| Bump | `ShaderNodeBump` | 5.0 | yes, in Displacement |
| Camera Data | `ShaderNodeCameraData` | 5.0 | yes, in Input |
| Checker Texture | `ShaderNodeTexChecker` | 5.0 | yes, in Texture |
| Clamp | `ShaderNodeClamp` | 5.0 | yes, in Utilities/Math |
| Color | `ShaderNodeRGB` | 5.0 | yes, in Input/Constant |
| Color Attribute | `ShaderNodeVertexColor` | 5.0 | yes, in Input |
| Color Ramp | `ShaderNodeValToRGB` | 5.0 | yes, in Color |
| Combine Color | `ShaderNodeCombineColor` | 5.0 | yes, in Color |
| Combine XYZ | `ShaderNodeCombineXYZ` | 5.0 | yes, in Utilities/Vector |
| Curves Info | `ShaderNodeHairInfo` | 5.0 | yes, in Input |

## Added to nodes of an older version

Sockets, settings and dropdown options a later version added to a node that an older version has already. With an older Blender each is left out of what is sent; the console names it where it matters (wired, or a value other than its default, which is what the older Blender does).

| Node | Added | From |
|---|---|---|
| Vector Math | option ROUND of operation | 5.1 |
| Normal Map | setting base | 5.1 |
| Normal Map | setting convention | 5.1 |
| Principled BSDF | input Thin Wall | 5.2 |
| Principled BSDF | option RANDOM_WALK_LEGACY of subsurface_method | 5.2 |
| Subsurface Scattering | option RANDOM_WALK_LEGACY of falloff | 5.2 |
| Raycast | setting active_index (which socket of the node's list of attributes is selected in Blender's sidebar; no effect on the render) | 5.2 |
| Attribute | input LightIndex (not in the node space: Blender fills it in itself) | 5.3 |
| Glass BSDF | input Anisotropy | 5.3 |
| Glass BSDF | input Rotation | 5.3 |
| Glass BSDF | input Tangent | 5.3 |
| Principled BSDF | input Transmission Dispersion Abbe Number | 5.3 |
| Principled BSDF | input Transmission Dispersion Scale | 5.3 |
| Vector Transform | input LightIndex (not in the node space: Blender fills it in itself) | 5.3 |
| Attribute | option LIGHT of attribute_type | 5.3 |
| Vector Transform | option LIGHT of convert_from | 5.3 |
| Vector Transform | option LIGHT of convert_to | 5.3 |

## Defaults that differ between versions

A new node in Cinema 4D takes the default of the newest version; the plugin sends every value, so a material renders the same on every version.

| Node | Socket or setting | Defaults |
|---|---|---|
| Principled BSDF | Subsurface Scale | 5.0: 0.05, 5.1: 0.05, 5.2: 0.005, 5.3: 0.005 |
| Mix | Factor_Float | 5.0: 0.5, 5.1: 0.5, 5.2: 1.0, 5.3: 1.0 |
| Subsurface Scattering | Scale | 5.0: 0.05, 5.1: 0.05, 5.2: 0.005, 5.3: 0.005 |
